default.shell:
---

{{ if .Vars.win11cis_level_1 }}
  {{ if .Vars.win11cis_rule_1_1_1 }}
command:
  win11cis_1_1_1_passwordhistorysize:
    title: "1.1.1 | Ensure 'Enforce password history' is set to '24 or more password(s)' | PasswordHistorySize"
    exec: |-
      powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$p = Join-Path '{{ .Vars.win11cis_snapshot_dir }}' 'SystemAccess.PasswordHistorySize'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p)) { 'NONCOMPLIANT not_collected' } else { $r = (Get-Content -LiteralPath $p -Raw).Trim(); if ($r -notmatch '^[0-9]+$') { 'NONCOMPLIANT actual=' + $r } else { $v = [int]$r; if ($v -ge {{ .Vars.win11cis_max_passwords_saved }}) { 'COMPLIANT' } else { 'NONCOMPLIANT actual=' + $v } } }"
    exit-status: 0
    stdout:
      - '/^COMPLIANT$/'
    stderr:
      have-len: 0
    timeout: {{ .Vars.timeout_ms }}
    skip: {{ if not .Vars.win11cis_domain_joined }}false{{ else }}true{{ end }}
    meta:
      skip_reason: "domain scoped - on a domain joined host the Default Domain Policy sets this [System Access] value, so the role does not apply it"
      workstation: 1
      CIS_ID:
        - 1.1.1
      NIST800-53R5:
        - IA-5(1)
  {{ end }}
{{ end }}

discussion: Imported from role task file `tasks/section_1/cis_1.1.x.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-11-CIS` and Audit control `section_1/cis_1.1.x/cis_1.1.1.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-11-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

odvs.description: win11cis_max_passwords_saved is the variable used to dictate the number of unique passwords that have to be associated with a user account before you can reuse an old password. The recommended state for this setting is 24 Or More passwords. NOTE: As of the publication of this benchmark, Microsoft has a maximum limit of 24 saved passwords. This may change at a later date but we have left it setup as a variable for that reason.
odvs.name: max_passwords_saved

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "1.1.1 | PATCH | Ensure Enforce password history is set to 24 or more passwords"
  when:
    - win11cis_rule_1_1_1
    - not discovered_account_policy_is_domain_scoped
  tags:
    - level1-corporate-enterprise-environment
    - patch
    - automated
    - rule_1.1.1
    - NIST800-171_3.5.2
    - NIST800-53R5_IA-5_1
  block:
    - name: "1.1.1 | PATCH | Ensure Enforce password history is set to 24 or more passwords | Set Variable"
      when: win11cis_max_passwords_saved == 24
      community.windows.win_security_policy:
        section: System Access
        key: PasswordHistorySize
        value: "{{ win11cis_max_passwords_saved }}"

    - name: "1.1.1 | AUDIT | Ensure Enforce password history is set to 24 or more passwords | Check for more than 24 saved passwords warning"
      when: win11cis_max_passwords_saved > 24 or win11cis_max_passwords_saved <= 23
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg:
          - "Warning!! You have an invalid number of maximum passwords set in win11cis_max_passwords_saved, please read"
          - "the notes for the variable and make the necessary change to the variable to be in compliance."

    - name: "1.1.1 | AUDIT | Ensure Enforce password history is set to 24 or more passwords | Set warning count"
      when: win11cis_max_passwords_saved > 24 or win11cis_max_passwords_saved <= 23
      ansible.builtin.import_tasks:
        file: warning_facts.yml
      vars:
        warn_control_id: '1.1.1'
